All Out (2021) was a professional wrestling event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW). It took place on September 5, 2021, at the Now Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois.

The main event of All Out (2021) was a highly anticipated match for the AEW World Championship between champion Kenny Omega and challenger Christian Cage. Omega successfully defended his title against Cage in a hard-fought battle.

Other notable matches on the card included:

- CM Punk's in-ring return after a seven-year absence, where he defeated Darby Allin.
- Britt Baker successfully defending her AEW Women's World Championship against Kris Statlander.
- The Young Bucks retaining their AEW World Tag Team Championship against the Lucha Bros in a steel cage match.
- Ruby Soho winning the Casino Battle Royale to earn a shot at the AEW Women's World Championship.
- Chris Jericho defeating MJF in a grudge match, forcing MJF to leave AEW if he lost.

Overall, All Out (2021) received positive reviews from fans and critics, with many praising the in-ring action and storytelling throughout the event.
